root_cause.text: The `ps_gamepad_create()` function in the `hid-playstation` driver fails to validate the return value of `input_ff_create_memless()`, allowing gamepad initialization to proceed even if force feedback setup fails.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the call to `input_ff_create_memless(gamepad, NULL, play_effect)` was modified to capture its return value in `ret` and return `ERR_PTR(ret)` if an error occurs, preventing potential crashes when force feedback effects are triggered.
